title: 第480章 发动兽潮
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“吼！！”

“嗷呜～”

“咕咕嘎嘎～”

火护山范围内的密林里，突然传出各种卡兽的吼叫声。

低沉的兽吼与尖锐的嘶鸣交织在一起，穿透层层密林，震得天空轰鸣、大地震颤。

“怎么回事！”

火护山寨子里，

熟睡的山贼们惊慌失措，衣衫不整地冲出石屋，人人面色惶恐，望向躁动不止的山林。

“老大，好像是地震。”

摩罗斯眉头一蹙，蹲下身用手仔细感应了一番这个动静。

“不对！不是地震！”

这地面震颤的感觉比地震轻多了。

“哨卫呢？死哪里去了？”摩罗斯厉声怒吼。

说话间，几个大汉从外面连滚带爬的地跑了进来。

“老，老大。是兽潮！是兽潮啊！”

听到兽潮两个字，众人皆是面色大变。

可摩罗斯依旧面不改色，眼神锐利的扫过众人。

“慌什么！一个兽潮而已，又不是没见过！”

“看清楚是从哪个区域过来的吗？”

几个哨卫面面相觑，哑口无言。

他们就是普通的御卡师，又没什么特殊手段，只能听见声音，看见动静，哪里能知道这兽潮的来源啊……

一众哨卫的沉默，瞬间点燃了摩罗斯的怒火。

“一群废物！拉下去喂火护犬！”

此言一出，那几个哨卫扑通一下跪倒在地，连连求饶。

“饶命啊老大，我们真不知道啊。”

“饶命啊老大……”

可惜，火护山不相信眼泪。

随着哀求痛哭的声音越来越远，一个瘦弱的男人也从黑暗中走了出来。

他抬手轻唤，一只侦察鸟振翅飞来。

身为山寨唯一的御兽师，唯有诺林拥有大范围探查能力。

“老大，兽潮是从西北方向袭来的，规模不小。”

“西北方向？”

摩罗斯眸光一沉，望向漆黑的西北密林。

“那是第一据点的位置。”

诺林走到他身旁，低声询问道：“老大，要不要去支援？”

Page (1/3)

"Roar!!"

"Ouch~"

"Cuckoo Gaga~"

In the dense forest within Huohu Mountain, the roars of various card beasts suddenly came out.

The low beast roar and the sharp neighing were intertwined, penetrating through the layers of dense forest, causing the sky to roar and the earth to tremble.

"What's going on!"

In the fire-protected village,

The sleeping bandits panicked and rushed out of the stone house in disheveled clothes. Everyone looked at the restless forest with panic on their faces.

"Boss, it seems like an earthquake."

Moros frowned and knelt down to carefully sense the movement with his hands.

"No! It's not an earthquake!"

The ground shaking felt much lighter than an earthquake.

"Where is the sentry? Where did he die?" Moros roared fiercely.

While talking, several big men rolled in from outside.

"Boss, boss. It's a tide of beasts! It's a tide of beasts!"

When they heard the word beast tide, everyone's expressions changed drastically.

But Moros remained expressionless, his eyes scanning the crowd sharply.

"Why are you panicking! It's just a beast tide, it's not like I haven't seen it before!"

"Can you see which area you are coming from?"

Several sentry guards looked at each other, speechless.

They are just ordinary card masters, and they don’t have any special means. They can only hear sounds and see movements. How can they know the source of this beast tide...

The silence of the sentries instantly ignited Moros's anger.

"A bunch of trash! Pull them down and feed them to the fire guard dogs!"

As soon as these words came out, the sentries fell to their knees and begged for mercy.

"Spare your life, boss, we really don't know."

"Spare your life, boss..."

Unfortunately, Huo Huoshan doesn't believe in tears.

As the sounds of begging and crying became farther and farther away, a thin man also walked out of the darkness.

He raised his hand and called softly, and a scout bird fluttered its wings and flew over.

As the only beast master in the village, Nolin is the only one with the ability to conduct large-scale detection.

"Boss, the beast tide is coming from the northwest, and it is quite large."

"Northwest?"

Moros's eyes darkened and he looked towards the dark forest in the northwest.

"That's the location of the first stronghold."

Nolin walked up to him and asked in a low voice: "Boss, do you want to go for support?"
